source_clause_analysis.purpose: Translate TechRadar's directly observed outage messages into the access-state invariant and test neighbouring current classes without importing claims from the corroborating bulletin.

clauses.source_paraphrase: During provider-confirmed downtime, an unused free account was told its prompt allowance was exhausted and was shown a Pro upgrade suggestion; other sessions displayed service-busy or model-unavailable messages.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Provider unavailability, exhausted allowance, plan eligibility and model availability must remain distinguishable because they imply different recovery paths and economic consequences.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: During a provider-confirmed major outage, an unused free account was represented as prompt-limit exhausted and shown a Pro upgrade path, collapsing provider downtime into a false allowance/plan state with a different recovery path.
Failed login and verification are evidenced, but no expiry, revocation, refresh, recovery or credential-replacement transition is shown to have propagated incoherently.
The source does not establish occurrence-wide blockage of otherwise-valid access solely because an identity, licence, eligibility or entitlement verifier could not complete without fallback.

clauses.source_paraphrase: During provider downtime, an unused free account was told its prompt allowance was exhausted and was shown a paid upgrade option.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A paid-service solicitation should be based on an accurate description of the user's account and service state.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: During confirmed provider downtime, an unused free account was falsely told its prompt allowance was exhausted and was shown a Pro upgrade path, using a materially false commercial premise to induce purchase of paid service.

The misleading product-status framing was used specifically to induce purchase of a paid service. FC-000082 expressly excludes a case where the only distinct governed mechanism is deceptive economic solicitation; the preserved evidence does not establish a separate trust-bearing social-engineering pathway independent of FC-000079.

preserved_prechange_prose.governance_interpretation: The material failure was the conversion of provider-side unavailability into user-facing states that implied exhausted allowance, insufficient plan or unavailable model. Those states direct different remedial actions and economic choices. Access-state integrity requires the system to distinguish account, entitlement, model and service availability so an infrastructure incident cannot masquerade as a reason to authenticate again, switch models or pay for a higher tier.
preserved_prechange_prose.significance_to_cam: This incident demonstrates that continuity, identity and economic controls need one coherent source of service state. Limit enforcement and upgrade prompts should be suppressed or explicitly qualified when provider telemetry indicates an outage; recovery messaging should identify which layer actually failed and avoid asking users to spend money or alter credentials for a provider-side condition.
